cases.title: A complete design, agreed step by step.
convo: A lesson on writing a volunteer bio.
Who they are, one thing they've done as a volunteer, and why they care.
Can describe a volunteer experience; can say why it matters to them; can write it in plain language.

cases.title: Six objectives were discussed.
convo: A lesson on budgeting with six objectives: track spending, set a budget, cut a cost, save weekly, read a bank statement, and plan one purchase.
That's a lot for 20 minutes; which matter most?
Probably tracking, setting a budget and cutting a cost, but keep whatever you think.

cases.title: Instructions for the coach, with a link and a code.
convo: A lesson on joining our community: learners share a screenshot of their first post.
Yes: share https://community.example.org/join and the code PLATO-2026 when they're ready.

cases.title: No instructions for the coach.
convo: A lesson where learners write three interview questions to ask an employer.
Can write open questions; can tailor them to the role.

cases.title: The author changed their mind halfway.
convo: A lesson on writing a résumé summary.
Actually, change it: make it a lesson on writing a cover letter instead.
Got it, a cover letter. What should the letter include?
A specific story and why they want the role. Call it 'Your First Cover Letter'.

cases.title: A thin conversation: a name and a rough idea.
convo: Something about time management. Maybe 'Plan Your Week'.

cases.title: The conversation was in Spanish.
convo: Una lección sobre escribir una biografía de voluntario.
Quiénes son, una experiencia como voluntario y por qué les importa. Se llama 'Tu biografía de voluntario'.
